descriptionHtml:
This session explored the evolving landscape of AI-driven development, guiding participants through the shift from casual, exploratory "vibe coding" toward disciplined context engineering for building production-ready applications. The talk offered practical insights and real-world perspectives that encouraged attendees to think beyond writing code and to build with clear purpose and intent.

Key Topics Covered

1. The Shift from Vibe Coding to Context Engineering

The discussion traced how AI-assisted development is evolving from ad-hoc, prompt-driven coding toward a more structured approach centered on providing AI systems with well-designed context to produce reliable, production-grade output.

2. Building with Purpose

Emphasis was placed on moving beyond simply generating code with AI, toward intentional design - understanding the "why" behind implementation choices and aligning AI-assisted development with real production requirements.

3. Practical Insights for Production-Ready Applications

The session shared real-world perspectives on applying AI tools effectively in professional development workflows, highlighting practices that help bridge the gap between quick prototypes and deployable, production-ready software.

Outcome / Impact

The session equipped participants with a deeper understanding of how AI-assisted development is maturing as a discipline, encouraging a more thoughtful and structured approach to building applications with AI - one grounded in context, intent, and production readiness.
